drive_alloy.substrate: cast and finish-machined nickel-chromium drive alloy
drive_alloy.manufacture: segmented casting, machined bearing faces, drilled clamp roots
drive_alloy.finish: heat-darkened conversion finish with directional service polish
drive_alloy.interface: bolted clamp segments over ceramic isolators and aft casing flange
drive_alloy.response: dark metallic broad highlights with restrained directional micrograin
drive_alloy.history: repeated hot-cycle discoloration and tool contact at service fasteners
drive_alloy.forbidden: cyan tire, rubber ring, molded plastic torus

ceramic_isolator.substrate: alumina-silicate electrical and thermal isolation ceramic
ceramic_isolator.manufacture: pressed segment, sintered, ground at clamp interfaces
ceramic_isolator.finish: unpainted warm-gray ceramic with localized soot
ceramic_isolator.interface: captured between drive casing and metallic load-clamp segments
ceramic_isolator.response: nonmetallic diffuse response with tight low-amplitude surface variation
ceramic_isolator.history: protected faces remain clean; exposed aft edges carry carbon haze
ceramic_isolator.forbidden: rubber gasket, plastic spacer, leather grain

refractory_vane.substrate: refractory superalloy skin over ceramic laminate
refractory_vane.manufacture: taper-formed vane with machined pivot root and folded stiffening edges
refractory_vane.finish: oxide-darkened hot face and cooler machined root
refractory_vane.interface: individual root pivots around the aft drive casing
refractory_vane.response: thin hard vanes with rough hot faces and metallic root glints
refractory_vane.history: aft-edge heat staining and unequal replacement age
refractory_vane.forbidden: rectangular chocolate block, LEGO chiclet, painted cube

pressure_shell.substrate: rolled and longitudinally welded low-alloy pressure shell
pressure_shell.manufacture: formed shell courses with welded seams and frame saddles
pressure_shell.finish: dark conversion coat with patch primer and restrained orange peel
pressure_shell.interface: captured by shoulder roots, keel, dorsal spine and drive bulkhead
pressure_shell.response: broad coated-metal response with shallow formed waviness only
pressure_shell.history: service access polish and local patching, not universal noise
pressure_shell.forbidden: rubber tube, leather wrap, clay cylinder

radiator.manufacture: corrugated louvers in a welded recessed frame
radiator.finish: oxidized dark metal with directional thermal grain
radiator.interface: replaceable bank seated into shoulder heat-transfer rails
radiator.response: thin rhythmic blades, dark recesses and directional metal highlights
radiator.history: leading-edge dust and uneven oxidation from repeated heat cycles
radiator.forbidden: floating rectangle sticks, rubber comb, solid plastic bars

sensor.substrate: machined aluminum-magnesium gimbal and conductive composite dish
sensor.manufacture: ribbed shallow dish, pivot yoke and replaceable feed horn
sensor.finish: dark low-glare coating with bare bearing faces
sensor.interface: bolted dorsal pedestal with visible yoke pivots and service lead
sensor.response: directional instrument; only the feed aperture emits
sensor.history: salvaged dish with one mismatched yoke arm and field-aligned stops
sensor.forbidden: neon hoop, lightbulb ring, decorative antenna circle

marking.substrate: stencil paint over the existing coated pressure shell
marking.manufacture: crew-cut stencil applied between service seams
marking.interface: paint layer follows the port shell surface
marking.response: legible ship identity without a floating plaque
marking.history: crew-applied gallows humor with restrained abrasion
marking.forbidden: inventory label, orange censor block, generated gibberish

coated_hull_panel.manufacture: cut, brake-formed and mounted to the pressure-frame structure
coated_hull_panel.finish: dark conversion coat or locally renewed primer
coated_hull_panel.interface: bolted or welded to named frame, hatch, keel or armor interface
coated_hull_panel.response: coated metal with broad highlights and restrained paint microstructure
coated_hull_panel.history: localized maintenance and contact wear only
coated_hull_panel.forbidden: clay slab, plastic shell, leather skin

armor_plate.finish: ceramic-rich matte protective coating over metallic substrate
armor_plate.interface: stood off from the pressure shell on visible load roots
armor_plate.response: hard planar response with distinct edge wear and no molded softness
armor_plate.history: impact repair and replacement age vary by plate
armor_plate.forbidden: toy wing, rubber slab, one-piece molded plastic

structural_metal.substrate: machined or welded structural aerospace alloy
structural_metal.manufacture: section-appropriate extrusion, machining, tube forming or weldment
structural_metal.finish: dark passivation or directional service-polished bare metal
structural_metal.interface: fastened, welded or pivoted into a named load/service path
structural_metal.response: metallic response whose grain and edge scale follow manufacture
structural_metal.history: tool contact and joint-local grime, not wallpaper scratches
structural_metal.forbidden: default gray plastic, floating bar, unexplained cube

cable_elastomer.substrate: braided conductor/line inside aerospace elastomer insulation
cable_elastomer.manufacture: extruded insulation over reinforced service line
cable_elastomer.finish: matte flexible jacket with metal terminations
cable_elastomer.interface: clamped at both ends and routed away from heat/contact zones
cable_elastomer.response: localized flexible nonmetal, used only at true cable/hose scale
cable_elastomer.history: compression and handling scuffs at clamps
cable_elastomer.forbidden: rubber hull, tire-like structure, leather grain

canopy.manufacture: hot-formed laminate with conductive and radiation-control layers
canopy.finish: dark conductive coating inside a metallic pressure frame
canopy.interface: captured by canopy rails and pressure seals
canopy.response: dense dark glazing with selective reflection and preserved depth
canopy.history: cleaned view sector with edge abrasion at the frame
canopy.forbidden: glowing plastic bubble, opaque toy glass

repair_panel.manufacture: field-cut and adapted to the original mounting pattern
repair_panel.finish: rough green patch primer over mismatched substrate
repair_panel.interface: clamps and adapter plates reveal the non-original fit
repair_panel.response: coated metal distinct from factory hull without becoming plastic
repair_panel.history: brush/roller application and localized grime around altered fasteners
repair_panel.forbidden: random green LEGO block, generic plastic box

active_aperture.substrate: glass/ceramic optical aperture in a metallic or ceramic housing
active_aperture.manufacture: small replaceable lens, lamp or emitter module
active_aperture.finish: clear or coated aperture with non-emissive surrounding hardware
active_aperture.interface: recessed into a named navigation, sensor, weapon or drive function
active_aperture.response: emission confined to the active aperture and readable without bloom
active_aperture.forbidden: glowing structural hoop, whole-surface neon decoration
